display_title: Where No One Has Gone Before

evidence.observation: During the test the Enterprise exceeds the normal scale and is measured approximately 2.7 million light-years away near M33; Kosinski calls the result his mistake while instruments and Data confirm the displacement.
evidence.qualification: Records what the transcript depicts or reports; no global fictional-world promotion is implied.

evidence.observation: The Traveler tells Wesley that space, time, and thought are not as separate as they appear and warns him not to repeat the idea; Kosinski continues claiming credit while Wesley tries to identify the assistant as the operative cause.
